Class PlayerController

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.controller.PlayerController
@Controller public class PlayerController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling player-related HTTP requests.

Manages player authentication (login, registration, logout), profile viewing and editing (including password changes and profile picture uploads), player card inventory, and username availability checks.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

    • checkUsername

      @GetMapping("/api/check-username") @ResponseBody public Map<String,Boolean> checkUsername(@RequestParam String username)
      REST endpoint that checks whether a username is available for registration.

      Returns a JSON response with an "available" boolean field.

      Parameters:
      username - the username to check
      Returns:
      a Map containing a single key "available" with a boolean value

    • showLogin

      @GetMapping("/login") public String showLogin(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles GET requests to /login and displays the login page.

      If the player is already authenticated, redirects to the player profile page.

    • processLogin

      @PostMapping("/login") public String processLogin(@RequestParam String username, @RequestParam String password, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      Handles POST requests to /login and processes player authentication.

      Verifies the provided credentials using BCrypt password hashing. On success, stores the player in the session and redirects to the profile page. On failure, displays an error message.

      Parameters:
      username - the username submitted in the login form
      password - the password submitted in the login form
      session - the HttpSession to store the authenticated player
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass error flash messages
      Returns:
      a redirect to /player on success, or /login on failure

    • processRegister

      @PostMapping("/register") public String processRegister(@RequestParam String username, @RequestParam String password, @RequestParam String confirmPassword, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      Handles POST requests to /register and processes new player registration.

      Validates that passwords match and meet strength requirements (minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, and one special character). Checks for duplicate usernames. On success, creates the player with 1000 initial coins and a BCrypt-hashed password.

      Parameters:
      username - the desired username
      password - the desired password
      confirmPassword - the password confirmation
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      Returns:
      a redirect to /login on success, or /register on failure

    • queryPlayer

      @GetMapping("/player") public String queryPlayer(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, @RequestParam(required=false) Integer playerId)
      Handles GET requests to /player and displays a player's profile page.

      If a playerId parameter is provided, displays that player's profile. Otherwise, displays the currently logged-in player's profile. If no player is authenticated, redirects to the login page.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass player and deck data to the view
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      playerId - optional player ID to view a specific player's profile
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("player"), or a redirect to /login

    • processProfileEdit

      @PostMapping("/profile/edit") public String processProfileEdit(@RequestParam(required=false) String oldPassword, @RequestParam(required=false) String newPassword, @RequestParam(required=false) String confirmPassword, @RequestParam(value="profilePicture",required=false) org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile profilePicture, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      Handles POST requests to /profile/edit and processes profile updates.

      Supports two types of updates:

      • Password change: Validates the current password, checks that new passwords match and meet strength requirements, then updates the hash.
      • Profile picture upload: Saves the uploaded image to the external data/images/players directory using the player's ID as the filename.

      Parameters:
      oldPassword - the current password for verification (optional)
      newPassword - the new password to set (optional)
      confirmPassword - the new password confirmation (optional)
      profilePicture - the uploaded profile picture file (optional)
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      Returns:
      a redirect to /profile/edit, or /login if not authenticated
